# Opened packaging and returns

## Eligibility
An unused Luma Shop purchase can be returned within 30 days of delivery.
Opened packaging is allowed, provided the item has not been used.

## Return shipping
Return shipping is free only when the item arrived damaged.
For all other returns, the customer pays the return shipping cost.

# X200 product manual

## Product identity
X200 is the Luma wireless headset model and follows the standard 30-day return policy.
The X200 headset supports Bluetooth and includes a USB charging cable.

## Battery supplier
The battery inside the X200 headset is supplied by NovaCells.
Use the order number and product model when asking support about an X200 battery.

# Refund settlement policy

## When money arrives
A refund starts after the warehouse receives and checks the returned item.
The money reaches the original payment method within five business days after that check.

## Refund records
A confirmation email is sent when the refund is issued.
A gift purchase can be refunded only to the original buyer.

# Warranty coverage

## Coverage
The warranty covers manufacturing defects for one year after purchase.
Accidental damage and ordinary wear are not covered by the warranty.

## Claim evidence
To request a warranty assessment, email support a photo and the order number.
A warranty assessment determines whether repair or replacement is available; it is not an automatic refund.

documents.rawText:

# NovaCells supplier replacement policy

## Replacement eligibility
NovaCells replaces a battery with a confirmed manufacturing defect within one year of purchase.
A NovaCells replacement request requires proof of purchase and the product serial number.

## Policy limits
NovaCells does not replace batteries damaged accidentally by the customer.
The supplier replacement policy is separate from Luma Shop returns and refund settlement.

# Archived extended returns policy

## Retired return window
The archived policy allowed unused purchases to be returned within 90 days of delivery.
This policy was retired and must not be used for current purchases.

## Old refund language
The archived policy described refund timing as ten business days after inspection.
Use the current returns and refund policies for present-day questions.

queries.label: A product code and a policy
queries.text: Can I return an unused X200 with opened packaging?

claims.text: The X200 follows the standard return policy: opened packaging is allowed if the item is unused, within 30 days of delivery.

queries.rewritten: X200 headset standard return policy opened packaging unused 30 days
subqueries: What return policy applies to the X200 headset?
Can an unused purchase with opened packaging be returned?
queries.hyde: A product manual identifies X200 as a wireless headset. A shop return policy may allow an unused headset with opened packaging to be returned within a stated window. Retrieve the actual policy before answering.

queries.label: Same meaning, different wording
queries.text: I unboxed my purchase but never used it. May I send it back?

claims.text: Yes, opened packaging is allowed if the item is unused; the return must be within 30 days of delivery.

queries.rewritten: unused purchase opened packaging return within delivery deadline
subqueries: Is opened packaging allowed for unused returns?
queries.hyde: A customer unboxed a product without using it. The relevant evidence is a return eligibility rule about opened packaging and unused items, together with the return deadline.

queries.label: Find two parts of an answer
queries.text: What is the return deadline, and when will the refund reach my payment method?

claims.text: An unused purchase can be returned within 30 days of delivery.
After the warehouse receives and checks the return, the money reaches the original payment method within five business days.

queries.rewritten: current return deadline refund settlement original payment method warehouse check
subqueries: How many days do I have to return an unused purchase?
How long after the warehouse check does a refund reach the original payment method?
queries.hyde: The answer needs two policies: a return eligibility deadline measured from delivery, and a refund settlement delay measured after the warehouse receives and checks the returned product.

queries.label: Follow a supplier relationship
queries.text: Which supplier made the X200 battery, and what is that supplier's replacement rule?

claims.text: NovaCells replaces batteries with confirmed manufacturing defects within one year; requests need proof of purchase and the product serial number.

queries.rewritten: X200 battery supplier NovaCells manufacturing defect replacement proof of purchase serial number
subqueries: What are NovaCells battery replacement eligibility and evidence requirements?
queries.hyde: A product can be linked to its component supplier, and the supplier can be linked to a replacement policy. The final answer must cite the X200 supplier fact and the supplier's actual eligibility rules.

queries.label: Read a delivery fee table
queries.text: My order is 40 dollars. What is the standard delivery fee?

claims.text: A 40-dollar order pays a 5-dollar standard delivery fee because it is at or below 50 dollars.

queries.rewritten: standard delivery fee orders 50 dollars or less 40 dollars
subqueries: What is the standard delivery fee for orders of 50 dollars or less?
queries.hyde: A delivery price table divides orders above a free-shipping threshold from orders at or below it. A 40-dollar order needs the lower-value order row, not the free-delivery row.

queries.label: Exclude an archived policy
queries.text: Which return deadline applies to a purchase today: 30 days or 90 days?

claims.text: The current return deadline is 30 days after delivery for unused purchases.

queries.rewritten: current policy unused purchase return deadline 30 days exclude archived 90 days
subqueries: What is the current return deadline?
Is the 90-day extended returns policy current?
queries.hyde: A current policy and a retired version can contain conflicting return windows. Current-purchase questions should search eligible current sources rather than treating an archived policy as equally authoritative.

queries.label: Do not erase the word not
queries.text: Does the warranty cover damage caused by an accident?

claims.text: No. Accidental damage and ordinary wear are not covered by the warranty.

queries.rewritten: warranty accidental damage not covered exclusions
subqueries: What kinds of damage are excluded from warranty coverage?
queries.hyde: A warranty may cover manufacturing defects while explicitly excluding accidental damage. The answer depends on the exclusion sentence, including its negation.

queries.label: Recognize missing evidence
queries.text: Does Luma Shop offer a student discount on the X200?
queries.rewritten: Luma Shop X200 student discount eligibility
subqueries: Is there an X200 student discount policy?
queries.hyde: A student discount policy would state eligibility and a discount amount. The available product or return documents alone cannot establish that such a policy exists.
